target_customer: Enterprise and high ACV B2B sales, customer success and revenue teams
problem: Reps do not know who they know inside a deal, who they are missing, or the fastest path to the decision makers, so enterprise deals stall.
business_model: B2B SaaS with a free tier for individual reps added in 2026

founders.name: Rachit Kataria
education: University of Southern California, BS and MS in Computer Science
founders.background_notes: The founders met as freshmen at USC.

founders.name: Will Wang
prior_employers: Slack (started the prototyping team, led Huddles launch)
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Building account maps from CRM, email and calendar data requires many integrations and entity resolution, standard engineering with hard data quality parts; founders came from Slack and Facebook.

defensibility.rationale: A graph of relationships across a customer's CRM, email and calls becomes embedded in deal workflows, but Salesforce and relationship tools like Introhive and Affinity could extend into it.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Salesforce Ventures invested in 2025 and Salesforce integrations are central; no acquisition found as of the 2026 Series A.

market_need_then: Enterprise sales deals involve large buying committees and reps lack visibility into relationships, which the YC launch posts framed as AI powered org charts for enterprise sales.

branding.domain_note: Uses usecentralize.com; the legal entity is Collate Labs, Inc. per the site footer.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and workmanlike: 'Every deal needs a map'

branding.brand_signature: Every deal needs a map tagline

brand_strength.rationale: Generic verb name with a clear tagline, but no press about the brand itself and the descriptor has shifted from relationship intelligence to deal workspace.

pivots.from: AI powered org charts and customer conversation insights
pivots.to: Relationship intelligence platform and then a relationship workspace for enterprise deal teams
pivots.why: Not stated; YC launch posts and the current site show repositioning, which sources do not call a pivot.

outcome_analysis: Centralize raised a reported $4M seed in October 2025 led by Salesforce Ventures and announced an NEA led Series A in July 2026, with $19M total raised per the company. Founders with Slack and Facebook backgrounds, strategic Salesforce backing and enterprise logos point to a working enterprise sales motion. Salesforce ownership of the CRM layer is the key risk. No revenue was disclosed.
notes: Company press release (Business Wire, 2026-07-29) states $19M total raised led by NEA; several outlets (SalesTools, AI Weekly, TamRadar, SeedTable) report a $15M Series A, consistent with $4M seed plus $15M. The Series A amount is that outlet figure, not a figure stated in the release snippet. Seed investor list beyond Salesforce Ventures unknown. Dealroom lists a $50M to $100M valuation range, an estimate not used. YC directory team size is 9 on the queue file and 6 on a snippet. No dated competitor sources near the batch were found; Introhive, Affinity and People.ai appeared only in undated comparison pages.
